question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f5f098157c32e144ef1716f08d1cfcc75280332358759e608f014ac1a4a20ed.png] 

The actual production of ACs in May is what percentage more than the average target production of ACs over the period of 5 months (correct to the nearest integer)?
solution:
Calculation:

The actual production of ACs in May = 120

The average target production of ACs over the period of 5 months = (60 + 30 + 80 + 90 + 100) ÷ 5 = 72

Hence, % = {(120 - 72) over 72} times 100\% ≈ 67%

**∴ The actual production of ACs in May is 67% more than the average target production of ACs over the period of 5 months.**
